name: Tracey DasGupta
headline: Director of Interprofessional Practice at Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre
about:
I am passionate about healthcare, quality of life, and leadership since becoming a nurse in 1991. My decision to become a nurse was influenced by my father who lived with muscular dystrophy. My area of nursing specialty is oncology nursing and I have fulfilled front line roles along the continuum of care in medical/radiation oncology, medicine/telemetry, palliative care and community nursing. I have also had the opportunity to continue to grow in roles such as Educator, Professional Practice Leader and Director of Nursing Practice. I am currently the Director of Interprofesisonal Practice at Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre. In this role, I am providing leadership for professional practice and the development and implementation of our Interprofessional Care (IPC) Strategy.
